summary: Ubisoft's anthology open-world shooter series; early console adaptations are tracked as separate releases where they substantially changed the PC original.

entries.title: Far Cry

primary.why: The original Far Cry was built for Windows and remains the highest-fidelity route; the console-focused Far Cry Classic is a later remake/re-release rather than a better primary.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows release through Steam, GOG, or Ubisoft Connect with widescreen/compatibility fixes as needed.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with modern compatibility-fix options.
all_releases.reason: primary: original and most configurable version.
skip: later console route, but PC remains more configurable and higher fidelity.
skip: later console route, but PC remains more configurable and higher fidelity.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Far Cry Classic exists on PS3/Xbox 360, but the Windows original remains the best high-fidelity route; the separate console redesigns are cataloged separately.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge Far Cry Instincts/Predator/Vengeance into this PC entry; they are separate console adaptations.

entries.title: Far Cry Instincts

emulation.notes: Original Xbox hardware remains the baseline.

primary.why: Far Cry Instincts is an Xbox-only console remake with changed level design and added feral abilities.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Xbox hardware or a verified Xbox emulation setup with an owned disc.

all_releases.reason: primary: only shipped platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: This is a changed console remake, not a straight port of the 2004 PC game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Catalog separately from Far Cry PC.

entries.title: Far Cry Instincts: Evolution

emulation.notes: Original Xbox hardware remains the baseline.

primary.why: Evolution is an Xbox-only sequel/standalone follow-up to Far Cry Instincts.
primary.how_to_play: Play on original Xbox hardware or a verified Xbox emulation setup with an owned disc.

all_releases.reason: primary: only shipped platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one platform release is sourced.

entries.remaster_caveats: Catalog separately from Far Cry Instincts and Predator.

entries.title: Far Cry Instincts: Predator

emulation.emulator: Xenia only if compatibility is acceptable

primary.why: Predator is the Xbox 360 package containing enhanced versions of Instincts and Evolution, making it the best single-console route for that branch.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 release on original/backward-compatible Xbox hardware if owned.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox 360 enhanced package for the Instincts branch.
all_releases.reason: primary: best single package for Instincts/Evolution on one platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Predator is the preferred package for this console branch.

entries.remaster_caveats: Still not a replacement for the original Windows Far Cry.

entries.title: Far Cry Vengeance

emulation.notes: Use real Wii controls or a carefully mapped motion setup.

primary.why: Vengeance is the Wii-specific adaptation of the Instincts storyline with motion controls.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Wii/Wii U hardware with original controls, or use Dolphin only if motion controls are mapped acceptably.

all_releases.reason: primary: only shipped platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one platform release is sourced.

entries.remaster_caveats: Motion-control adaptation; catalog separately from Instincts/Predator.

primary.why: Paradise Lost is the arcade light-gun Far Cry spin-off listed in the series release history.
primary.how_to_play: Play on the original arcade cabinet or a properly preserved arcade setup; normal home-console advice does not apply.
